content: The use of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) is linked to a significant reduction in anxiety related to blood sugar fluctuations. It also contributes to a lower risk of diabetes-related complications. By providing real-time feedback on glucose levels, CGM enables users to make immediate adjustments to their lifestyle or treatment regimen. This capability fosters a sense of control and empowerment, ultimately enhancing the quality of life for both patients and their caregivers.
